title: Chapter 295 Bloodthirsty Demon Wolf
content:
Chapter 295 Bloodthirsty Demon Wolf

Wang Shuo is now a high-level general, but he is still not strong enough to fight a gold boss alone.

If his qualifications were S-level or even SS-level since level one, it would be possible.

Hearing Su Xiu's introduction, Wang Shuo showed a solemn look.

He didn't know what the strength of Changping County was.

"I don't know how many troops did Brother Su bring this time?"

Wang Shuo picked up the tea bowl and scraped the tea leaves.

This tea was given to Wang Shuo by those merchants.

"5,000 cavalry."

Wang Shuo's face was stern. It seemed that Su Xiu's strength was not inferior to his own.

Including the brothers of Nanshan Society, Wang Shuo had nearly 6,000 troops under his command.

Except for the crossbow battalion, they were all cavalry. Even the crossbow battalion was equipped with war horses, and could be used as cavalry at critical moments.

Afterwards, the two exchanged some information and discussed the next battle plan.

But the strength still seems a bit weak. You know, this time the undead army is all the main force of the Burning Legion. Not only is the organization complete, but there are also arms divisions.

Such as undead knights, giant axe skeletons, skeleton archers, etc.

If they fight head-on, there is almost no chance of winning.

After the two added friends, Su Xiu left Wang Shuo's camp.

Their own strength is not enough, and they cannot attack rashly. They need to wait for more allies.

At the same time, near a huge undead altar.

A huge bloodthirsty demon wolf is sitting on a simple throne.

This wolf is the supreme commander of all the Burning Legions in Changping County.

All the senior generals of the Burning Legion gathered around him, and they were discussing how to attack Changping County.

Logically speaking, they could have attacked the city long ago. The reason why they didn't take action was because the supreme commander of the entire Burning Legion, General Arif Ubol, asked them to stay put for the time being and cooperate with him to attack the capital of Hedong County.

Originally, the Bloodthirsty Wolf was guarding General Arif Ubol, but he was sent here because the warrior of Changping County, the Ice and Fire Wolf, had fallen.

The Bloodthirsty Wolf was very angry about the fall of the Ice and Fire Wolf.

Takker, the leader of the Burning Legion who was responsible for attacking Nanshanji, was kneeling in the field at this time.

"Describe the situation at that time again."

"Yes, sir."

As a senior general, Takker was trembling with fear at this time.

Takker described in detail how the Ice and Fire Wolf was killed by Wang Shuo.

He did not exaggerate.

"So, you ran away?" The Bloodthirsty Wolf asked harshly, opening his bloody mouth and revealing sharp fangs.

Although they were all skeletons, the higher the level, the more features they would retain on their bodies, such as some skin covering the skeleton, and even some clothes.

Takker immediately begged for mercy.

The bloodthirsty wolf spewed out an energy ball, which directly knocked Tucker dozens of meters away.

He hit a big rock, and his scattered skeleton began to burn.

Finally turned into ashes.

Several crystals fell on the spot.

The four top generals around the bloodthirsty wolf dared not breathe.

"Who of you is willing to kill this Wang Shuo?"

At this time, a skeleton wearing a helmet stood up: "I am willing to share your worries."

The bloodthirsty wolf looked at Falati. As a top general and a powerful undead knight, the bloodthirsty wolf felt that he should be able to deal with a small lord.

"Okay! I hope to hear good news from you."
